exam.title: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with two or more years provisioning, operating and managing AWS plus SDLC and programming/scripting experience. Practice build-once promotion, testing, multi-account IAM, artifacts, deployment strategies, reusable IaC, account foundations, resilient automation, telemetry, incident response and continuous security/compliance.

review.notes: The current six-domain DOP-C02 guide was reconciled with every detailed domain page, the live 180-minute/75-question/USD-300 certification page and non-exhaustive service list. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks cover build-once artifact provenance, tests and deployment safety; reusable IaC and multi-account desired state; capacity, bounded self-healing and tested recovery; centralized outcome-driven telemetry; evidence-preserving incident response; and supply-chain, identity, data and continuous-compliance controls. All 18 URLs are cataloged: 17 reachable and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Current-service/training metadata is labeled and no recalled questions are used. September 17, 2026 delivery maintenance: checked the live AWS certification page and added the applicable language retirement or replacement-exam notice, including conflicting vendor dates where present. Existing objective snapshot and full-review dates remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.
